children: Oracle set a FY30 revenue target of $225 billion or more and expects positive free cash flow of at least $30 billion in FY29.
Oracle targets FY30 revenue of $225 billion+, more than 35% CAGR from FY26, with non-GAAP operating margin of 40%+ and EPS of $21+.
Oracle expects positive free cash flow in the second half of FY28 and targets $30 billion+ in FY29 as capital expenditures step down.
Oracle plans to limit additional capital-market funding for FY27–FY30 to $20 billion, split between $10 billion in equity and $10 billion in gross debt.
Oracle expects growth to be self-funded beginning in FY29 and net debt to adjusted EBITDA below 3.5 times that year.
Oracle reaffirmed its FY27 outlook for revenue of at least $90 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $8.10.

title: Oracle Targets $225 Billion+ Revenue and $30 Billion+ Free Cash Flow by FY29
